scope_vocabulary.HISTORICAL: it happened, and nothing here says it still holds
scope_vocabulary.CANONICAL_VERIFIED: bound to a revision that still describes HEAD, on whatever host; this is what 'the federation has been verified' means
scope_vocabulary.CURRENT_ENV: canonical, and taken on this machine inside the freshness window; this is what 'it works here, now' means
scope_vocabulary.CURRENT_LIVE_PROBE: produced by a probe this run executed, not read from a file

classification_vocabulary.VERIFIED_LIVE_NOW: something this run executed against it came back
classification_vocabulary.VERIFIED_HISTORICALLY: a bound, still-describing-HEAD record says it worked; no one has asked it anything since
classification_vocabulary.CONFIGURED_NOT_PROBED: the registries name it and nothing has tried it
classification_vocabulary.CATALOG_ONLY: it appears in a catalogue of candidates and is configured nowhere
classification_vocabulary.CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED: reaching it needs a credential this environment does not hold; that is a fact about this environment, not about it
classification_vocabulary.LICENSE_GATE_REQUIRED: reaching it needs a licence acceptance that has not been recorded
classification_vocabulary.UNAVAILABLE: it was reached, or reachably attempted, and cannot serve
